status: fixed; focused regressions and final full suites passed locally

finding.source: A distribution can omit daily's detached signature while the embedded signature does not authenticate its build time.
finding.before: The update CLI returned partial/unverified, but later CLI/MCP checks and malware scans returned completed/fresh from the date alone.
finding.reproduction_before_fix: Two new regression methods failed on the base implementation: four check/single/batch/resume subcases returned completed/fresh, and the real MCP SDK check returned completed/fresh.
finding.invariant: A private generation cannot establish fresh without retained, content-bound evidence of a verified daily detached signature. Age limits still apply.

implementation.record: <generation>.verification.json beside the three-CVD generation directory; private regular file, schema 1, content digest, exact database versions and detached-signature statuses
implementation.read_boundary: pin snapshots the record with the reference and shared lease under the publication lock, then verifies CVD contents outside that lock; core's shared definition-check gate applies the retained result to CLI/MCP and all malware entry points
implementation.missing_or_invalid: Missing legacy records, invalid/deep JSON, unsupported schemas, extra fields, mismatched content/versions, invalid statuses, unsafe permissions, links, cloud placeholders and unreadable records cannot authenticate freshness; no implicit write or download is attempted
implementation.date_semantics: A recent date without verified daily evidence is unverified/partial; stale, unknown and future-date handling stays unchanged, including the inclusive age limit and one-microsecond-over boundary
implementation.publication: Durably write stage/verification.json, flush candidate CVDs, place the generation and evidence and sync the root before switching current.json; pre-switch failures retain the prior pointer and pending/stage
implementation.unchanged: For identical full CVD content only, preserve matching earlier verified evidence or upgrade the same generation after a new verification; do not transfer proof to different bytes even when versions match
implementation.resume: CVD-only digest, generation paths and checkpoint identity remain unchanged; metadata-only refresh does not invalidate matching scan results, while reports retain unknown_definitions for unverified evidence
implementation.maintenance: Generation revision and byte count include the sidecar. Selected deletion validates both objects and removes evidence before the generation under its exclusive lease. A partial deletion leaves any remaining generation unverified. Failed stage verification.json is a recognized maintenance entry.
implementation.compatibility: Legacy stores stay readable and updatable; a verified unchanged owner update can create their record. OS-managed definition checks keep their existing behavior.

review.investigation: Independent read-only security-boundary and compatibility investigation before editing
review.candidate_review: One fresh read-only bypass/regression review of the candidate diff found no concrete surviving bypass or regression across publication, unchanged updates, legacy records, pinning, CLI/MCP, scan variants and maintenance
review.scope: The detached-signature evidence lifecycle only; no repository-wide scan, dependency update or OSV re-query

cases: Absent daily signature stays unverified in checks, single scans, batch scans and resume with unknown_definitions
Real MCP SDK checks and scans preserve the unverified result without disclosing the store path
Actual CLI subprocess check and scan return exit 2, partial/unverified and unverified progress using a synthetic engine
Legacy, malformed/deep JSON, schema/content/version/status/extra-field errors, public permissions and linked records cannot establish fresh
Unchanged updates upgrade or preserve matching proof, repair a missing legacy record, and refuse proof transfer to different bytes with equal versions
A pinned reader keeps its generation's proof across publication of a new unverified generation
Exact age limit, one microsecond over and future dates with verified and absent proof
Record-write and record-placement failures preserve the prior pointer and pending/stage
Maintenance revision and byte accounting bind the sidecar; stale revisions are refused and selected deletion removes both objects
Failed stage verification records remain selectable through owner maintenance
